title: Dự án Phát hiện Gian lận Thẻ tín dụng (Credit Card Fraud Detection)
summary: A credit card fraud detection project that trains XGBoost classifiers while comparing four data-resampling techniques (undersampling, BorderlineSMOTE, CTGAN, and TVAE) to address extreme class imbalance. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer, driven by SingleTableMetadata, to generate synthetic minority-class fraud samples for training data augmentation.
evidence: preprocessing.py:2-3 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer'; all.ipynb:729 'ctgan = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=100, ...)'
